description: Installation of an air conditioning unit on the ground floor at the rear of the property
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal">The
rating level of the noise emitted from the new AC unit shall be at least 10dB
below the existing background noise level.&nbsp;The noise levels shall be
determined at the boundary of the nearest noise sensitive premises.&nbsp; The
measurements and assessment shall be made in accordance to the latest British Standard
BS4142:2014<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">&nbsp;</p><p>



</p><p class="MsoNormal">REASON: To ensure
that the proposed development does not give rise to noise nuisance to
neighbouring residents<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 11pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: 638 10 Location plan; 638 11 Existing plans; 638 12 Proposed plans; Floor plan; Heritage Statement; Air conditioning unit noise details; Document 2 floor plan; Document 4 plan Land Registry Location Plan

<p class="MsoNormal">All new external and
internal works and finishes and works of making good to the retained fabric
shall match the existing adjacent work with regard to the methods used and
materials, colour, texture and profile, unless shown otherwise on the drawings
or other documentation hereby approved or required by any conditions(s)
attached to this consent. <o:p></o:p></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoNormal">REASON: To protect
the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 11pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>
